task.pr_title: wikibase: Improve recon name for created entities

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
We'll need to make sure the old format of such Change objects can still be deserialized correctly, so that operations run with previous versions of OpenRefine can still be done and undone correctly. So there should be two tests: the current one (unchanged) and another one for the new format.

To make this backwards compatibility simpler, I would recommend using two separate maps (one for the entity ids, one for the names) instead of storing pairs of values in maps. It's probably worth updating the Java types accordingly.
